verdict.rationale: Vanta's developer site has per-endpoint API reference pages, such as list tests, upload contract and create custom control. The list-controls page tells users to pick a server from a dropdown to issue requests, which points to an interactive try-it console. However, the only evidence of interactivity is that one line, and no runnable code samples are shown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the try-it console and its authentication flow, runnable code examples per endpoint, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (probes of the standard paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Select `Vanta Gov (FedRAMP)` from the server dropdown to issue requests against `https://api.vanta-gov.com`.
Lists all tests based on applied filters.
Upload a contract. Rate limit: 10 requests / minute.
